title: The Payment forms, Buy now buttons, and Invoicing System | GetPaid WordPress plugin before 2.8.63 does not check that…
description: A vulnerability in the GetPaid WordPress plugin versions before 2.8.63 allows unauthenticated users to view invoices without proper authorization. The plugin's single-invoice shortcode does not verify if the visitor is permitted to see the invoice, and the payment-form embed page can render any invoice ID for unauthenticated users, exposing sensitive customer information including names, billing addresses, phone numbers, line items, and payment status.
